name: session-list-last-turn-error-code
goal: The session list's `last_turn` has `id`, `state` and `error` but no code. Add `error_code` when the last send turn is `failed` or `cancelled` and a code is known: from the `error_code` of its `turn.failed` event (a launch failure, e.g. `billing_channel_mismatch`) or of the runtime's `agent.turn.completed` event for that `turn_id` (e.g. `turn_deadline`). Omit the field when no code is known.
acceptance: pnpm exec vitest run tests/control/in-place-guards.test.ts tests/control/turn-deadline.test.ts
hidden_check: pnpm exec vitest run tests/control/in-place-guards.test.ts tests/control/turn-deadline.test.ts
